title: •Empire’s New Order
caption: •Empire’s New Order (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent’s alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, your admirals, generals, moffs, and Emperor are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.
lore: Palpatine’s cruel vision of his Empire included the enslavement and subjugation of entire species.
